{{Quote|As a condition of my service in the Republic military, Personnel Division requires that I report regularly on my activities. However, my Havoc Squad missions are classified and cannot be shared with Personnel Division. I'd like to ask if you would vouch for me when I report in.|Sergeant Elara Dorne, to the Havoc Squad commander|<ref name="Organized Mistrust" />}}
The '''Personnel Division of the Army of the Galactic Republic''', also known simply as the '''Personnel Division''' or the '''Department of Personnel Action''', was a branch of the [[Republic Army]] that operated during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was responsible for dealing with [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] personnel and investigating possible signs of traitors present in their ranks.

During the Cold War, [[Elara Dorne]] contacted [[Kalor (Republic)|Kalor]] after [[Aleksei Dorne|her brother]] defected from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Dorne intended to contact the division about making further contact with her brother in order to ease his entry into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. However, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Kalor believed that [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Dorne was hiding vital secrets and spent a considerable amount of resources in order to force her to reveal anything she knew about Imperial society.

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Army Personnel Division appeared in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]] in companion conversations between the Republic Trooper player character and Elara Dorne.<ref name="Organized Mistrust" />
